lines.text: In this town, nobody whistles after sunset and we leave the Whistler milk every night.
You see, something in the dark whistles back.
So every night, Mom pours it a saucer of milk.
Nobody remembers why we owe it.
Mr. Plunk forgot the milk once.
Now his front door whistles itself open.
Mrs. Crumb pours extra and gets a free bagel every Friday.
The mailman pays too. The Whistler sorts his letters by whistle.
I'm Gus, the loudest whistler in town.
I've never once been quiet at sunset.
Mom tapes a scarf over my mouth at dinner.
My best friend is my dog, Waffles.
And in my pocket, a plastic kazoo from the milk raffle.
Until one night, I forgot the milk.
Then I whistled. Only one note.
Outside, something whistled back.
Higher. Closer. Right under our window.
The porch light flickered.
Our front door began to hum.
It whistled itself right off its hinges.
Mom screamed. Waffles hid in the laundry.
A tall shadow stepped in, lips puckered like a flute.
Then I saw the deal stuck on our fridge.
Nobody whistles after sunset. Nothing whistles back.
It said nothing about who pays.
We paid milk for its silence.
But if I keep making noise, it can't answer.
It has to pay us to stay quiet.
I pulled out the kazoo.
Bzzzzz!
The Whistler flinched. Its lips squeezed shut.
I kazooed until sunrise.
Every honk, it wanted to answer.
But the deal said nothing whistles back.
By morning, it was shaking and sweating.
It opened its coat and poured out milk.
Twelve bottles for Mom. Twelve for Mr. Plunk. Twelve for everyone.
Mrs. Crumb got a bagel too.
Now the Whistler pays us milk to stay silent.
Mr. Plunk's door finally stopped whistling.
Here nobody whistles after sunset, and nothing whistles back. Not even the milk.

post.title: Nobody whistles after sunset. Gus did anyway.
post.description: Gus forgot the milk and whistled at the dark, and something whistled back. Then a plastic kazoo turned the deal around.

card.opener: In this town, nobody whistles after sunset, and every night we leave the Whistler milk so nothing whistles back.
card.title: The Night Whistler's Milk
card.premise: Gus is the town's loudest whistler, and his mom keeps paying the Whistler a nightly saucer of milk for a debt nobody remembers making.
card.price: Skip one night's milk and by morning the Whistler has taken your front door.
